subject: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive with ML/Infra (60-90 min) - Pulse Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive with ML/Infra (60-90 min) - Pulse Analytics

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — great context on your ingestion pipeline and model latency targets. Quick recap and proposal for next steps: 

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Primary use case: near-real-time insights on streaming patient telemetry (~50 req/s burst).
- Key constraints: 200ms P95 latency for short responses; sensitive PHI data, need VPC/on-prem options.
- Current infra: Kubernetes + GPU instances, in AWS us-west-2.

Proposed next step
- Schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML/Infra team and your ML/Infra leads. Goal: align on architecture, integration approach (batch vs streaming), security controls (KMS/HSM, audit logs), and performance tuning (batching, KV cache, quantization).

Proposed agenda (60–90 min)
1) Intros & objectives (5–10 min)
2) Your current infra + data flow (10–15 min)
3) Redwood architecture & integration options (25–30 min)
   - serving runtime, KV/prefix caching, batching strategies
   - dedicated vs private deployment tradeoffs
4) Performance/cost levers + sizing discussion (10–15 min)
5) Security/compliance checklist (10 min)
6) Action items & next steps (5 min)

Possible slots next week (all PT):
- Tue 2027-04-11: 10:00–11:30
- Thu 2027-04-13: 08:30–10:00 or 10:00–11:30

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (ML lead, infra/ops, security)? Also please confirm whether you want us to include a short perf demo (30 min) into the session — we can prioritize caching/batching and KV cache warmups.

I've attached a short agenda doc for reference. Once you confirm a time I'll send a calendar invite and include Dylan (SE) and Camila (Solutions Ops) to help with logistics and post-call notes.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
